topic.title: Magic Johnson's whole NBA career paid about $40 million: how owning businesses made him a billionaire

title: The basketball star who got rich off the court 🏀
description:
Did basketball really make Magic Johnson a billionaire?
His whole NBA career paid about $40M. Owning businesses did the rest.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Would you rather be paid or own? Comment

lines.text: Basketball made Magic Johnson a billionaire? Watch this.
His 13 NBA seasons paid him about $40M.
So how is he worth $1.6B today?
Because he stopped working for owners and became one.
He bought into a life insurance company and sports teams.
But that fortune is far bigger than anything basketball paid him.
Basketball paid a salary. Owning paid a fortune. Which pays you?
